title: Have Engram's test launcher report a passing run's completion to the host, so a correct check on an Engram project isn't refused
outcome: Engram's own scripts/test-launcher.mjs carries TermAl's agreed completion handshake, so a passed, clean registered run in an Engram checkout gives the host its run-end measurement instead of leaving a later close to assume a source change
acceptance: Engram's launcher performs the handshake agreed on TermAl's w-d6b6165a6661, in both foreground and detached paths, once that protocol is fixed in TermAl's source
A host that lacks the handshake, an unavailable host and a standalone run all keep today's behaviour and result: the handshake never turns a passing run into a failure and never adds a retry
A real-host run in an Engram checkout using Engram's own launcher shows a passed clean run followed by an unchanged close accepted and done, and a real edit refused
No Engram storage, evaluation or barrier code changes under this item
disposal_reason: Greg approved the one-check model („tak”, Asistant #279): no completion handshake is built, and the launcher's default selection is now part of w-633b5cacc42a.
